scientific_question: Can the source-defined full Toller T-matrix be pointwise dominated, away from pair-collision loci, by the hyperbolic edge kernel used in Kaminski's 3-edge-connected EPRL integrability theorem, thereby localizing any remaining causal-vertex divergence to collision strata rather than noncompact infinity?

authorities.toller_source: Bianchi-Chen-Gamonal, Toller matrices and the Feynman i-epsilon in spinfoams, Phys. Rev. D 114, 046014 (2026), Cartan/KAK Eq.(13), asymptotic statement following Eq.(13)
authorities.causal_vertex_source: Bianchi-Chen-Gamonal, Causal spinfoam vertex for 4D Lorentzian quantum gravity, Phys. Rev. D 113, 126020 (2026), causal vertex Eq.(4), Toller KAK Eq.(7)
authorities.comparison_theorem: W. Kaminski, arXiv:1010.5384, Theorem 2: for every 3-edge-connected graph, product edge kernel (cosh r_e)^(-(1-tau)) is integrable with tau=1/(2|E1|)

logic.angular_bound: Eq.(13)/(7): finite SU(2) Wigner sums imply |T_pm(g)| <= (2*min(j,l)+1)*max_m |t_pm_m(beta)| because each compact Wigner entry has modulus <=1
logic.away_from_collision: For every fixed delta>0 and fixed finite labels with physical real rho away from Toller poles, t_pm(beta) is continuous on beta>=delta; asymptotic e^{-beta} is stronger than (cosh beta)^(-0.95), so a finite label-dependent C_delta exists for all beta>=delta.
logic.graph_comparison: On D_delta={all K5 relative rapidities r_ab>=delta}, the absolute causal integrand is bounded by C_delta times the Kaminski K5 comparison kernel. Since K5 is 3-edge-connected, the comparison integral is finite.

required_checks: exactly verify every nontrivial K5 cut has at least three crossing edges
verify source worst radial exponent 1 is strictly larger than Kaminski comparison exponent 0.95
verify the finite-dimensional KAK angular prefactor is finite for all frozen j
numerically verify max_m,branch |t(beta)|*(cosh beta)^(0.95) remains finite on every frozen lane for beta>=0.5
retain collision exclusion explicitly; do not infer behavior as beta->0
scope_guard: PASS localizes the remaining fixed-label causal-vertex finiteness problem to neighborhoods of pair/multi-pair collision strata r_ab->0. It does not prove collision integrability, full causal-vertex finiteness, generalized EPRL-KKL normalization, spin/refinement sums, causal-stack cutoff removal, D7-S3/S4 closure, terminal D7 authorization, or Candidate Gravity activation. It is not an automatic transfer of representation composition; it uses the source-defined Toller KAK formula directly.
